components.text: Deductible and a co-payment both shift part of cost to the policyholder, but they work differently: deductible is paid first and a co-payment is a share of the claim. Room-rent limits are especially important because some policies apply proportionate reduction to other to other hospital expenses if room chosen is above the eligible limit. Waiting periods and exclusions coverage filters, so if a claim falls inside them, claim may be denied even if hospital bill is genuine.
